description: This file defines the interface for the ocudulog logging framework, including functions for managing log channels, loggers, formatters, sinks, and framework configuration. It declares functions, templates, and classes related to logging operations, with a focus on thread safety and extensibility.

classes.name: log_channel
classes.description: Represents a logging channel used for categorizing log messages.

classes.name: log_channel_config
classes.description: Configuration settings for a log channel.

classes.name: sink
classes.description: Abstracts a destination for log messages, such as files, stdout, syslog, or network sockets.

classes.name: log_formatter
classes.description: Defines how log messages are formatted before being written to sinks.

classes.name: basic_logger
classes.description: A simple logger that writes to a sink, with optional context printing.

classes.name: error_handler
classes.description: Type for handling errors within the logging framework.

methods.name: find_log_channel
methods.description: Finds a log channel by its ID string.

methods.name: fetch_log_channel
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a log channel with specified configuration.

methods.name: create_log_channel
methods.description: Creates and registers a new log channel (deprecated).

methods.name: fetch_basic_logger
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a basic logger with optional context printing.

methods.name: fetch_logger
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a logger of a specific type with given arguments.

methods.name: create_basic_logger
methods.description: Creates and registers a basic logger (deprecated).

methods.name: set_default_log_formatter
methods.description: Sets the default formatter for new sinks.

methods.name: get_default_log_formatter
methods.description: Returns the current default log formatter.

methods.name: create_text_formatter
methods.description: Creates a plain text formatter.

methods.name: create_contextual_text_formatter
methods.description: Creates a plain text formatter that adds context.

methods.name: create_json_formatter
methods.description: Creates a JSON formatter.

methods.name: set_default_sink
methods.description: Sets the default sink for log channels and loggers.

methods.name: get_default_sink
methods.description: Returns the current default sink.

methods.name: find_sink
methods.description: Finds a sink by its ID.

methods.name: fetch_stdout_sink
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sink writing to stdout.

methods.name: fetch_stderr_sink
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sink writing to stderr.

methods.name: fetch_file_sink
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a file sink with optional max size and EOF marking.

methods.name: fetch_syslog_sink
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a syslog sink with specified preamble and local facility.

methods.name: fetch_udp_sink
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a UDP socket sink.

methods.name: install_custom_sink
methods.description: Installs a user-defined sink into the framework.

methods.name: create_stdout_sink

methods.name: create_stderr_sink
methods.description: Creates a stderr sink (deprecated).

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the logging framework.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes all registered sinks.
